summary: New briefing focuses on the Gap section's center Smart Recommendation screenshot retaining full iPhone chrome (time 23:43, Dynamic Island/notch, Wi-Fi, battery, top border), all three screenshots rendering uncropped at natural 921:2000 ratio with object-fit contain, no hover/selection transform re-introducing cropping, and a balanced/responsive three-phone composition. Added 1 new browser check (gap-chrome-visible-no-hover-crop) directly asserting chrome visibility, natural-ratio preservation, and hover-stability of the image box/transform. Re-ran 3 pre-existing browser checks (gap-flagship-entrance, gap-screenshots-aspect-ratio-contain, mobile-and-reduced-motion-accessible) to confirm no regressions. All 4 checks passed; visual screenshot inspection confirms 23:43 time, notch, Wi-Fi and battery icons fully visible on the center phone with no overflow at desktop. No backend/API surface backs these purely visual/CSS criteria (static content-driven portfolio, consistent with prior iterations).
backend_note: No app-specific backend endpoints back any of the 4 criteria in this briefing; no backend test files were added.

checks.criterion: O screenshot central Smart Recommendation exibe todo o chrome original do iPhone (horário 23:43, Dynamic Island/notch, Wi-Fi, bateria, borda superior)
checks.name: gap-chrome-visible-no-hover-crop
checks.evidence: Visual screenshot of gap-smart-recommendation-image-slot shows '23:43' time text, notch/pill shape, Wi-Fi and battery icons, and top border fully intact. Assertions: img.naturalWidth/Height>0, natural ratio ~921/2000 (within 10%), computed object-fit==='contain', rendered box ratio within 8% of natural ratio, ancestor frame overflow !== 'hidden'.

checks.criterion: Os três screenshots do Gap ficam integralmente visíveis e sem distorção (contain, altura automática, sem corte)
checks.name: gap-screenshots-aspect-ratio-contain
checks.evidence: Re-run by name only (persisted script): all 3 slots visible, images loaded, object-fit=contain, overflow=visible, rendered ratio matches natural 921/2000 within 5% at desktop(1280x900) and mobile(390x844), no horizontal overflow at either viewport.

checks.criterion: Nenhuma transformação de hover ou seleção volta a cortar os screenshots (após animação inicial estabilizar)
checks.name: gap-chrome-visible-no-hover-crop
checks.evidence: After waiting for entrance reveal to settle and image to load, captured img computed transform/object-fit/bounding-box before and after hover on the center slot: object-fit remained 'contain', transform unchanged (or 'none'), bounding box width/height delta < 2px, confirming no re-crop on hover.

checks.criterion: A composição de três telefones continua equilibrada e responsiva (central maior por largura de coluna, rótulos corretos, sem overflow em desktop e 390x844)
checks.name: gap-flagship-entrance
checks.evidence: Re-run by name only (persisted script): all 3 slots visible with valid img src/naturalWidth, iphone-prominent class only on Smart Recommendation slot, labels (START WITH TIME / SMART RECOMMENDATION / CONTEXT & PRIORITY) rendered correctly, New Task interactive button toggled aria-pressed=true.

regression_checks.name: mobile-and-reduced-motion-accessible
regression_checks.evidence: Re-run by name only (persisted script): passed at mobile viewport with prefers-reduced-motion, no regressions.
